definitions.gloss: occurring one after another, successive occurrence
definitions.explanation: Events, incidents, or problems arising in succession over a period of time. Typically used for negative events such as accidents, crimes, or complications.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{続発|ぞくはつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{窃盗|せっとう}→窃盗：15280_settou⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{続発|ぞくはつ}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Theft cases keep occurring one after another in this area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{術後|じゅつご}→術後：15639_jutsugo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合併症|がっぺいしょう}→合併症：12076_gappeishou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{続発|ぞくはつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{入院|にゅういん}→入院：02091_nyuuin⟧⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{延|の}びた→延びる：19599_nobiru⟧。
examples.english: Because complications arose one after another after the surgery, the hospital stay was extended.

notes:
Almost exclusively used for negative events — accidents, crimes, complications, disasters, and similar problems. Unlike ⟦{連発|れんぱつ}→連発：20863_renpatsu⟧, which can describe any rapid repetition including positive things, {続発|ぞくはつ} strongly implies a troubling pattern of incidents arising in sequence.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{続発|ぞくはつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: accidents occur in succession
- ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{続発|ぞくはつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: incidents occur one after another
- ⟦{合併症|がっぺいしょう}→合併症：12076_gappeishou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{続発|ぞくはつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: complications arise in succession
- ⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{続発|ぞくはつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: damage/harm keeps occurring

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{連発|れんぱつ}→連発：20863_renpatsu⟧: rapid repetition — same action repeated in quick succession; can be positive or negative
- ⟦{頻発|ひんぱつ}→頻発：14670_hinpatsu⟧: frequent occurrence — emphasizes high frequency, less focus on sequential pattern
- ⟦{多発|たはつ}→多発：20508_tahatsu⟧: frequent occurrence — similar to ⟦{頻発|ひんぱつ}→頻発：14670_hinpatsu⟧ but more neutral/statistical
